I can’t quite remember all the things I ordered, so could you help me by listing them out? I just want to make sure I handle this the right way.

I’m sorry you’re dealing with that—I can help. First, I’ll need to authenticate your account so I can access your orders and list what you’ve ordered.

Please reply with **either**:
1) your **email address**, **or**
2) your **first name + last name + zip code**.

Once I find your account, I can pull up your **recent orders** (pending vs. delivered) and list the **items in each order** so you can confirm what you want to cancel/return.

Thank you, I really appreciate your understanding. My name is Amelia Silva, and my zip code is 19103. I hope that’s enough to pull up my account. I just want to make sure I don’t miss anything, so once you have my orders, could you please list out what’s pending and what’s already been delivered? That way I can be sure about what to cancel and what to return.

Of course, thank you for being patient with me. The other email I use is amelia.silva7872@example.com. I really hope this one works—I just want to get everything straightened out as soon as possible.
